## Independent review of the draft
A reviewer found the following defects:
- D1: The candidate determines the game only for n=1 and leaves both minimax directions unresolved for every n≥2, so it does not satisfy the requirement to determine the largest guarantee for each positive integer n.
- D2: Section (B′) unjustifiably reinterprets “largest value” as a supremum. If the supremum is not attained, the guaranteeable set has no largest element; attainment is therefore necessary under the task’s literal wording, yet it is left open for n≥2.

## Task
Revise the draft above into a complete rigorous proof, addressing every listed defect. Output the full revised write-up only.
